title: Mixed Event — Let's Enjoy Together! SpoJoy Park — Episode6 My Own Feelings

meta.Event Outline: Kanade's fatigue has been catching up to her as of late. Worried that it might affect her compositions, she decides to put effort into building her stamina alongside Ena. They hear that a new sports facility called SpoJoy Park just opened near the station...

rows.Line: SpoJoy Park

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Ahh...
Delicious water.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (A morning walk and rollerblading to bubble sumo... I didn't think I could do so much in one day.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(But I'm getting tired...
I might be so sore tomorrow that I can't move...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (This is fun...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, I remember doing things like this when I was little...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Things were fun back then too.
I roller skated, went on a trampoline...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
What else did I do...?
I remember trying to hit some sort of target with a ball...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, it was strike zone.
I think Dad was the one who taught me how to throw the ball.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Hehe. That takes me back...
I wasn't very good at throwing it, but Dad stepped in to show me how...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I almost forgot. I'm here to work on my stamina so that I can keep composing songs...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (I'm supposed to be working on creating a song that can save everyone, but I'm...)

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. Are you enjoying yourself?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, I am.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't get many chances to have fun somewhere that's so lively and dynamic.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: My shoulders feel lighter too, so I'm glad that I came here today.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <And yet, you seem somewhat concerned.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I initially came here because I wanted to increase my stamina so that I can keep composing, but I just started having fun instead.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I was reflecting a bit on that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
<Oh, what's wrong with having fun?
You came all this way, so why not enjoy yourself?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I have to keep composing for my dad and Mafuyu...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Hehe. You're always thinking about others, Kanade.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <You should think more about how you're doing from time to time.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: How I'm doing?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes. Like having fun because you want to have fun, or doing the things you want to do.>

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Which is why no one will find fault with you if you take this opportunity to spread your wings and really enjoy yourself.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I see...
Kanade!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Hanasato...?
Is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, I came to buy some water!
Also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I was wondering if you were okay.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, because you weren't feeling well the other day. I was worried that I made you push yourself a little too hard...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh... No, I'm okay. There's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? I'm glad to hear that you're fine...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, after we take a quick break, let's go around to see what else we can do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And we can do something less strenuous and more fun this time! Maybe something simple, like the trampoline!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Fun...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry, but I'd like to do something a bit more challenging...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I appreciate the concern you're showing for me, but since I'm here, I want to increase my stamina as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because if I don't, I would've skipped working on music for nothing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay!
In that case, let's do something that requires us to be active and move our bodies!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What you said just now was so cool too. You want to do something challenging for the sake of your music!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I didn't really mean it like that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I just want to be able to compose a song that can save people... I need to do everything I can to achieve that...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Compose a song that can save people...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes. A song for those who really need it...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
That's my goal...
That's what I have to compose...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I see. I understand now that composing a song that can save people is really important to you, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: It is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Which is why I don't have time for fun...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Kanade...!
Would it be alright for me to give you my support?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I-If that's not what you want, it's okay...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'd like to do so because now I know that you have something that means so much to you.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Your support...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Right now, you seem a bit exhausted because you're trying so hard...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, I'm sorry too!
You don't have to apologize!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Um... In my case...
If I keep pushing myself after deciding to do something, I start getting really tired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, if you think you need it, Kanade, even if things get really tough or difficult, I want to give you my support in a way that helps you move forward...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I-I'm so sorry!
I know I'm being really nosy right now...!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No, you aren't.
I actually really appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But why are you willing to do so much for me...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh? Why...?
Because...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It's kinda hard for me to put into words, but I think it's because you're working so hard for the sake of other people...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Which is why... Even if it's just for now, I want you to smile!

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Smile...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(It's hard for me to describe this...
But...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Someday, after Mafuyu learns to really feel again... Like Mom, when we went to that one place...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want her to smile...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, I'm sorry.
I wasn't expecting to hear anything like that is all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait, why?
Isn't it normal for friends to want their friends to smile?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (Friends...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
And I don't think I'm alone.
I believe Ena, Ichika and everyone in your group feel the same way.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: You really think so...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Hey, there they are!
Kanade! Minori!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're thinking about trying something else next. Is there anything you'd like to do?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Anything I'd like to do...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: In that case, would you mind if we...?
